jobs.employer_name: BASF Services Europe GmbH
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO BASF

We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems, connecting seeds and traits, crop protection, digital tools and sustainability approaches. We strive to deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth
Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions vision & mission!

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
We in Agricultural Solutions are preparing to be an independent, pure-play agricultural company within BASF group. To be ready for independence, we are looking for you to join us in our new Corporate roles (see here: build your career on our Standalone Transformation).

- As part of the establishment of a standalone tax function for the Agricultural Solutions business, you will play a key role in building and embedding robust transfer pricing governance from the ground up.
- In your new position, you maintain AP's intercompany transfer pricing (ICTP) governance framework and ensure consistent application of policies across all relevant entities.
- You support the selection, implementation, and day-to-day management of transfer pricing IT systems and tools, ensuring data integrity and process automation.

Together with your colleagues, you coordinate the preparation and alignment of master files and local files with the operational Tax advisors and ensure timely, audit ready documentation.
- In addition, you oversee data quality, support the implementation of governance updates, and contribute to the standardization of transfer pricing processes across Agricultural Solutions.
- Last but not least, you secure audit readiness by maintaining transparent documentation, preparing responses to audit requests and supporting risk assessments.

WHAT YOU OFFER

- completed university degree in taxation, business administration, economics or a comparable field
- at least six years of professional experience in transfer pricing, tax governance or a related finance environment
- solid knowledge of intercompany transfer pricing concepts, documentation requirements and financial process flows
- very good German and English skills
- experienced with transfer pricing software/tools and a strong IT affinity, ideally including system ownership or implementation experience
- proven track record of collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder relationships in a multinational environment

WHAT WE OFFER

- A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility.
- A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation.
- Inspiring networks for the development and implementation of your ideas (e.g. Women in Business)
- Career paths as professional development into other roles within the company.
- We actively support with childcare (e.g. company daycare, holiday programmes) and provide a fitness and health studio as well as a medical center with numerous offers for your health.
- We offer sustainable mobility benefits — a discounted Deutschlandticket for regional public transport, a job‑bike leasing program, and on‑site e‑charging stations for private electric vehicles to make your commute affordable, healthy, and climate‑friendly.

jobs.employer_name: thyssenkrupp AG Entgeltabrechnung
jobs.description:
Unternehmen

thyssenkrupp nucera offers world-leading technologies for high-efficiency electrolysis plants. The company has extensive in-depth knowledge in the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrochemical plants and a strong track record of more than 600 projects with a total rating of over 10 gigawatts already successfully installed. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy a major step towards a climate-neutrality.
www.thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

Aufgaben

As Project Director, you carry overall accountability for the successful delivery of strategically critical Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication (EPF) projects in the field of alkaline water electrolysis or chlor alkaline electrolysis . You lead at executive level with ownership to deliver complex projects covering engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, and commissioning on schedule, at cost and at quality. The role requires business judgement, solution orientation, technical credibility and the ability to manage international teams, drive decisions and secure results in complex settings with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and customers.
Your responsibilities will include:

- You hold end-to-end accountability for the full EPC project lifecycle, from bid support and handover into execution through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and final handover to the client
- You establish the project execution plan and own the interface to all internal and external executive level project stakeholders, in order to lead complex projects with clarity, speed and control
- You integrate engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, commercial management and contract administration into one integrated global, cross-functional and intercultural project team
- You challenge bid assumptions, execution concepts, schedule logic, partner models and resource plans before project start in order to secure realistic and executable baselines
- You own delivery performance against schedule, cost, margin, cash flow, quality and contractual commitments and intervene early where deviations threaten project outcomes
- You actively govern technical, commercial, contractual and interface risks and ensure that mitigation, recovery and decision measures are implemented with discipline
- You safeguard contractual entitlement through structured change management, claim strategy, escalation handling and robust decision documentation
- You act as the primary interface to project sponsors, steering committees, customer decision-makers and key external partners in critical project matters
- You are able to dive into technical problem solving when required, bring credible depth in at least one relevant technical field, and drive your execution team toward timely, robust and executable decisions
- You lead critical project situations with clear priorities, direct interventions and fact-based decisions, including phases of instability, recovery or major change
- You strengthen the project organization by guiding Project Managers and senior discipline leads and by setting a clear standard for execution discipline and accountability

Profil

- You have completed a degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline
- You have extensive experience of more than 10 years leading major EP / EPF / EPC(m) projects in the chemical or energy business with high technical, contractual and stakeholder complexity
- You have a proven track record of steering projects through difficult phases such as bid-to-execution transition, execution ramp-up, major contractual changes, recovery and in periods of significant delivery pressure
- You combine executive presence with delivery discipline and are able to lead large cross-functional and intercultural organizations without relying on disciplinary authority
- You bring strong command of project economics, including cost forecasting, margin protection, cash development, schedule impacts and recovery planning
- You understand how contract strategy, change management and claims affect project outcome and know how to steer these topics together with the commercial function
- You bring sufficient technical depth in at least one relevant field and are able to structure, challenge and steer engineering-driven solution development
- You make sound decisions under uncertainty and create clarity in situations with incomplete information, multiple interfaces and high stakeholder pressure
- You hold a recognized senior project management certification, such as PMP or an equivalent qualification
- You are fluent in English and preferably also German
- You are willing to undertake extensive international travel as required by the project and are prepared to accept extended assignments abroad when necessary

Das bieten wir

As part of the thyssenkrupp group, we offer our employees high level conditions and many benefits:

- performance-related compensation according to collective agreement Metal undamp; Electro NRW
- attractive old-age provision models
- groupwide learning measures
- thyssenkrupp Group health campaigns and programs
At thyssenkrupp nucera, we attach great importance to individual needs - to this end, we are constantly developing as an employer and offer a wide range of benefits for your perfect working-life-balance:
- In an environment characterized by flat hierarchies and a lot of personal responsibility, we create space for individual development.
- We offer further training and support in line with your individual strengths and goals in order to optimally accompany your career path.
- In intercultural and interdisciplinary teams, communication at eye level is our top priority.
- Flexitime, part-time, home office, mobile working abroad: whenever possible, we give you the flexibility you want for your work.
- For the perfect office days, we provide state-of-the-art equipment at our global locations as well as quiet and communal areas for every situation.
- For a potential move to a location near the office, we will support your relocation organizationally and financially - also internationally.
- Your personal business buddy will be at your side during your induction - so new starters quickly get to know the company, the department and their colleagues.
- If that's not enough for you: by working on green hydrogen technologies, we are ensuring clean energy for the future. Be a part of it: new era is you.

As a Projektmanager Order Implementation (f/m/d), you will be responsible for leading projects in the new manufacturing and service of generators, generator components, and other electrical machines for both internal and external industrial business. You will act as the central point of contact for customers throughout the entire order fulfillment process, ensuring a smooth and successful project execution from design to delivery. 

Your key responsibilities include the independent coordination of customer requirements, aligning interfaces, deadlines, and delivery scopes with internal technical departments. This involves monitoring project milestones, controlling progress, identifying technical challenges, and actively supporting the development of solutions to meet project goals on time and within budget. In this role, you will also build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, manage factory acceptance tests, and organize customer visits to ensure high satisfaction. Furthermore, you will contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for product and process optimization, supporting the initiation of these measures, and documenting lessons learned.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Function as the central point of contact for customers throughout the entire order fulfillment process, including design, manufacturing, testing, and shipping
* Independently coordinate and address customer concerns and requirements as well as oversee and manage factory acceptance tests and organize customer site visits
* Coordinate interfaces, deadlines, and delivery scopes with internal technical departments to ensure a seamless project flow as well as control project milestones, monitor overall project progress, and report on status
* Identify technical challenges and collaborate with relevant teams to support solution-finding
* Build and maintain strong relationships with relevant internal and external stakeholders to foster collaboration
* Support the initiation of optimization measures and document lessons learned for future projects

What You Bring

* Completed university degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable qualification, alternatively, completed vocational training with further education and several years of professional experience in a similar field
* Initial experience in project management, order processing, or a customer-facing environment as well as initial experience in the areas of power converter technology (HVDC and FACTS), high-voltage technology, digital simulation technology and as control and automation technology
* Proficient use of MS Office applications, Knowledge of SAP R/3 modules SD and MM is desirable
* Strong communication skills, customer orientation, analytical thinking, assertiveness and conflict management
* Very good command of German (written and spoken) as well as very good command of English (written and spoken)

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network,diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. jobs.description:
Company Description

At METRO, we’re more than a global food wholesaler. We are ONE METRO: a diverse team of over 85,000 colleagues across more than 30 countries, united by one mission: enabling our 15 million customers to create meaningful moments in hospitality and independent trade.

We shape the M with passion, commitment, and growth mindset. This means taking on responsibility, making our company your company and creating a business together that remains true to its roots but always seeks new solutions.

Job Description

The Corporate Security, Safety and Forensics team has a vital role in protecting people and assets at METRO. The team is responsible for dealing with security risks as well as possible violations of laws and regulations, both nationally and internationally. It carries out security assessments, security audits, and fraud investigations. It creates appropriate guidelines and audit mechanisms and coordinates the regional and local Security managers. In the event of suspected violations of laws or internal regulations, the team investigates the incidents and reports to the senior management. In addition, the corporate safety function ensures a safe working environment by developing and monitoring company-wide safety standards and preventive measures. The Corporate Security, Safety and Forensics team is part of the Audit, Asset Protection & Governance division. You will support the team in two areas, security and forensics.

Your tasks:

- Loss Prevention: Support initiatives aimed at reducing shrinkage, protecting company assets, and strengthening operational resilience.
- Incident Management: Oversee and coordinate security incidents, liaising with emergency services and authorities as needed, and manage, maintain, and develop the security incident management system.
- Crisis Management: Support and coordinate the crisis management process, including maintaining crisis management guidelines, designing and delivering training, and conducting security risk assessments for current and prospective operations.
- Risk Assessment: Continuously monitor and evaluate evolving threat landscapes, providing recommendations to mitigate emerging risks.
- Security Programs & Compliance: Manage travel security programs for international travelers, coordinate internal security communications, develop and implement corporate security and forensics policies, and perform OSINT background checks to support corporate integrity and compliance objectives.
- Investigations & Event Security: Conduct fraud investigations, interviews, and analyze physical and electronic documentation to prepare investigative reports and ensure security planning and coordination for corporate events and conferences.

Qualifications

Your profile:

- Education: University degree in business informatics, accounting, business management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
- Experience: Minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience, preferably at a Big4 audit firm, in investigations, or within the security function of an international company.
- Technical Skills: Proficient in MS O365 Suite, especially Excel, and ERP systems.
- Languages: Very good English and German skills (both written and oral).
- Personality: Team player with an accurate, analytical, and open-minded approach, complemented by a can-do attitude.
- Flexibility: Willingness to adapt to changing priorities and work environments, including occasional business travel.

Additional Information

What we offer:

- Work-life balance: Flexible working hours in agreement with your line manager, 30 days of holiday.
- Training: A comprehensive training offer via our own training center or externally.
- Well-being: Health days with lots of health checks and information about your well-being, company medical care including a range of preventive services, such as flu shots, OTHEB employee assistance program.
- Exciting life on campus: Free gym and sports classes, Rioba coffee bar, canteen with discounted meals for employees, many campus events.
- Discounts: discounted Jobticket as well as discounts in our wholesale stores and at many partner companies.
- Comfort: Good transport connections, free parking spaces, JobBike.
- Company pension plan: You will receive a contribution to your company pension.
- Family driven: Three daycare centers for children on campus, support of holiday camps for children of employees.

WE ARE HIRING

Attorney-at-Law (m/f/d)
Commercial Law (North Macedonian Law) – Full-time or Part-time (min. 30h/week)
Location: initially Dresden, Germany / prospectively North Macedonia

WHO WE ARE

At RIEDIGER. legal | tax, we are not a traditional law firm with dusty files and dictation. We are an international, digitally oriented team of over 60 lawyers, tax experts, and accountants across Germany, the Czech Republic, and Poland, delivering outstanding work. We provide holistic, practical, and forward-looking advice to businesses—both legally and tax-wise.

A particular focus of our work lies in international and cross-border matters. Looking ahead, we plan to establish our own office in North Macedonia at a central location (e.g., Skopje, Bitola, Ohrid, or similar). We see significant economic and legal potential there and aim to develop this location deliberately and responsibly, closely connected to our existing offices.

WHAT WE OFFER

- A strategically exciting position with an international perspective
- Thorough onboarding and close support during the initial phase
- An interdisciplinary and appreciative working environment
- Clear structures, short decision-making processes, and genuine trust
- The opportunity to actively help build and shape a new office location
- Long-term collaboration with development prospects
- Permanent full-time or part-time employment (min. 30h/week)
- Predictable and flexible working hours with electronic time tracking
- A modern, well-equipped workplace
- A strong team culture: shared breakfasts, team events, and celebrations that strengthen cohesion
- Further training opportunities through seminars, training sessions, and individual programs, even during the probation period
- Free beverages, massages, parking options, and attractive additional benefits such as a monthly tax-free non-cash benefit of €50

WHAT YOU BRING

- You are a fully qualified lawyer (advokat) with solid knowledge of North Macedonian law, with a focus on commercial law
- You are a well-rounded commercial lawyer, not narrowly specialized
- Ideally, you have 2–3 years of professional experience (not mandatory)
- Business-fluent German or English skills (one of the two is required), as well as openness to using translation tools in daily work
- A high willingness to travel between Germany and North Macedonia

What matters most is that you are open to new legal and economic topics and are able to familiarize yourself with international and cross-border legal matters, particularly EU law, private international law, and relevant treaties. In addition, you bring economic and organizational understanding, as well as enthusiasm for building structures and contributing entrepreneurially.

You work in a highly independent and structured manner and demonstrate integrity, discretion, and loyalty toward the firm and our clients. You communicate effectively, even across distances.

You think long-term and entrepreneurially and are able to find creative solutions to complex economic and organizational challenges.

YOUR PERSPECTIVE

- Your place of work will initially be in Dresden, Germany, for 1–2 years.
- During this time, you will gain a comprehensive understanding of our working methods, client structure, firm culture, and interdisciplinary collaboration with our tax advisory team.
- At the same time, you will be regularly involved in project-based work in North Macedonia.
- The experience and structures gained in Germany will be gradually and transformatively transferred to North Macedonia and will play a key role in establishing and supporting a new office there.
- The exact location will be determined jointly and is intentionally kept open.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Providing legal advice to companies in a business-oriented environment
- Advising under North Macedonian law in the field of commercial law in its full scope, in particular: - Corporate law (including company formations, restructurings, and dissolutions)
- Drafting and negotiating contracts
- Supporting location decisions and investment projects
- Employment law matters
- Interfaces with tax law in close cooperation with our tax advisors
- Advising on funding opportunities and business-related regulatory frameworks
- Supporting and actively shaping business processes
- Building, maintaining, and developing client relationships
- In the long term: co-establishing and independently managing a law firm office in North Macedonia in close coordination with the Dresden office
- Regular professional and organizational exchange with the German team

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU

Are you interested in joining us on this journey of building a new office in North Macedonia and looking for a long-term position explicitly designed as an employment relationship? Then let’s talk.

bewerbung@riediger-legal.com

Ms. Sophie Kahl | sophie.kahl@riediger-legal.com | +49 351 4383708 517
Ms. Marija Treneva | marija_treneva@yahoo.com

- good understanding of group accounting policies and IFRS interpretations, as well as hands-on experience with financial reporting and disclosure tools and their interfaces
